scope: Static audit of the 33 Retry 16 phase executors and retained evidence; no retry or Phase 31.5 execution performed.

classification_rules.FULLY_VERIFIED: The executor performs the claimed operation, asserts its result and retains identifiable evidence sufficient to independently verify the claim.
classification_rules.PARTIALLY_VERIFIED: A relevant operation executes, but the assertion or retained evidence does not prove the complete claimed guarantee.
classification_rules.STRUCTURAL_ONLY: Only static shape, registration or dependency structure is checked.
classification_rules.NO_OP: The executor returns PASS without a valid phase operation or assertion.
classification_rules.OVERCLAIMED: The executor's assertion is materially weaker than the phase guarantee while the retained result reports PASS.

systemic_findings: PhaseExecutionResult.status is ignored by V25ExecutionSession.run_phase; any callback return without exception is rewritten to PASS.
Twelve phases have neither native_operation nor direct service and therefore take the default PASS branch at runtime.py:571-579.
EVENT_OUTBOX_ASSERTIONS checks only for authorization_id in session.composition and performs no event, outbox or audit query.

Eleven late phases share one branch that checks only authorization_id and returns verify_live_phase_evidence PASS; it does not materialize a graph, compare values, test security, inspect migrations, emit closure evidence or verify teardown.
The retained live bridge serializes phase_id/status/error only; it drops PhaseExecutionResult operation, native source, metadata, assertions and in-memory captures.

required_design_correction.default_pass: Reject registration or execution when a phase lacks an operation and explicit assertions; PhaseExecutionResult.FAIL must propagate and PASS must require non-empty evidence references.
required_design_correction.exact_comparison: Serialize every live capture/readback, resolve all 1664 fields from those retained values, reject captured:* and fixture identities, then compare independently canonicalized live and expected graphs.
required_design_correction.security_evidence: Execute named positive and negative role/RLS/tenant/authorization probes and retain query, principal, expected outcome and observed outcome.
required_design_correction.event_outbox_assertions: Query DomainEvent, TransactionalOutbox and ImmutableAuditLog by retained IDs/trace_id and compare payload hashes, aggregate identities and transaction linkage.
required_design_correction.teardown: Run teardown outside the business phase loop, then perform a separate post-teardown inspection of containers, networks, volumes, ports and database reachability.
required_design_correction.phase_evidence: Each phase result must retain executor identity, inputs hash, operation/readback IDs, assertion list, artifact paths and hashes.
